description: Documented CWE-78 sites in three public, deliberately vulnerable Python applications. Positives only: no site in these applications is labeled safe.
prepared: 2026-11-14, before any scan of these sources by this project

sites.evidence: README.md lists "11. Command Injection" and documents GET /uptime/FLAG as passing command line flags into the system call; display_uptime builds "uptime -" + flag and this is the only process call in the file
README.md lists "Command Injection" without naming a file; get_users builds "dig " + request.args.get('hostname')
README.md lists "Command Injection"; run_file builds "/bin/bash " + request.args.get("filename")
Windows variant of the same route: "nslookup " + request.args.get('hostname')
Windows variant of the same route: "cmd /c " + request.args.get("filename")

sites.code: res = subprocess.run(["ps aux | grep " + name + " | awk '{print $11}'"], shell=True, ...
sites.evidence: README.md names ./flask_webgoat/actions.py:43, the comment "# vulnerability: Remote Code Execution" on the line above this call
